6162.title: Diff viewport offset is lost on tab remount
6162.rootCauseOneLine: The fixed diff tab unmounts its virtualized scroll element without retaining its offset; only file-card UI state survives.
6162.proposedFix: Trace virtualized card remeasurement and add deeper browser regression coverage before choosing a complete offset or file-anchor restoration strategy.
6162.caveats: Same agent repeated the baseline reproduction in a second clean checkout. A local candidate passed component checks but shifted 6000px to 5172px in-browser, so no fix was pushed. Reproduction tests and output are inline.
